key.name: length
key.description: Length of the generated password (between 4 and 32).

key.name: use-lower
key.description: Include lowercase letters (a-z) in the password.

key.name: use-upper
key.description: Include uppercase letters (A-Z) in the password.

key.name: use-symbols
key.description: Include special characters (!@#$%...) in the password.

key.name: exclude-ambiguous
key.description: Exclude characters that look similar (l, I, 1, o, O, 0, |).
